# Giftora — Online Gift Shop India

> Giftora is an online gift shop based in Delhi, India. We offer same-day gift delivery across Delhi NCR and major metros (Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Jaipur) on orders placed before 5 PM, and express delivery to 60+ cities across India. Our range includes cakes, flowers, teddy bears, clothes, shoes, sunglasses, belts, plants, toys, and gift combos. Orders are placed online and hand-delivered by our local delivery network; international gifting for NRIs in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and Africa is also supported.

## FAQ — Direct Answers

> Giftora delivers same-day across Delhi NCR and major metros on orders placed before 5 PM, and express delivery across 60+ cities. Every gift is wrapped with a personalised card. NRIs can order from the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and Africa using international cards. Payment methods: UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, wallets and international cards. Midnight cake delivery is available across Delhi NCR — Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad and Ghaziabad. Delivery runs 7 days a week, including weekends and public holidays.
